frozen_semantics_preserved: NOT_COVERED / L0 / L1 / L2 decided upstream only; never created, upgraded or rescued here
SCOPED_EMPIRICAL is an annotation on L1
L0 never learner-facing; absence never drawn or implied as falsity
IN and OUT are distinct relation identities and never merge
LRoleSim consumed as frozen ranks/scores only; nothing feeds back
R* comes from the frozen set-cover stage and is consumed unchanged
LRoleSim matching bipartite graph != choice-evidence bipartite graph
direct_identifier = local structural specificity, not human difficulty

graph_model.left_nodes: A/B/C/D = Answer + 3 distractors, letters assigned by a seeded recorded permutation
graph_model.right_nodes: counterpart entity nodes (kind ENTITY, pinned KG) plus one CLASS node (remote category provenance)
graph_model.edge: (choice, kappa=(predicate, direction), counterpart) observed in the pinned snapshot
graph_model.clue_group: (kappa, counterpart) = one clue sentence; support(g) = choices having that edge
graph_model.atomicity: all edges of a group are exposed together so no partial exposure implicates a false absence
graph_model.in_edges: stored as (c,(p,IN),x), drawn node->choice, verbalized with the IN template, never merged with OUT
graph_model.node_identity: normalize_uri then semantic-index canonical equivalence when available; containment never merges nodes; label merging forbidden
never_contains: left nodes outside the four choices

sources: distractor one-hop facts from the pinned KG via the frozen enumeration
fact_universe.bounding: optional tier truncated to N_max (candidate 200) by a deterministic pre-key; scope recorded as UNIVERSE_FULL or UNIVERSE_BOUNDED

objective.form: integer-weighted utility maximised under hard constraints; evidence semantics are constraints/tiers, never weights

preferred.method: exact 0-1 ILP (CP-SAT or CBC) over the declared universe, solved for pre-answer then nested post-answer
preferred.fallback: greedy, recorded as CE_SOLVER_UNAVAILABLE_GREEDY_USED, never silent
reasons: weights are honest for pedagogical trade-offs

pre_vs_post.design: one universe, one scoring model, two nested selections (S_pre subset of S_post)
pre_vs_post.consistency: nesting + universe + atomicity + no negative edges; residual implicature measured by abs_g and covered by the legend

determinism: integer objective, one worker, fixed seed

budget_sensitivity.data: development batches (329 + 189 Answers, v4 outputs, offline)
budget_sensitivity.choice_rule: pre-registered knee rule on marginal gain per node with COVER_ALT feasibility >= 95%; B_pre smallest with >= 90% items having every letter in an optional clue

interface.package: src/choice_evidence_v1/ (contracts, universe, grounding, objective, select_exact, select_greedy, select_legacy, graph, clues, metrics)

reusable: shared objects >= 2 owners as a preference

known_issues_not_repaired: granularity_clean.apply_granularity_policy reports STATUS_NO_RISK_PRESENT under report-only even with nonzero incidences; read the incidence count, not the status
an unverbalizable fact can sit in a main-L1 rationale (contract vs kernel contradiction)
human_decisions: H1 R* always in the clue set
H2 grounding vocabulary vs generic classifier
H11 pre-registration of the budget rule
